title: Leukocyte compositional entropy did not improve periodontal pocket-depth prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: Five-part leukocyte entropy did not establish added prediction of mean periodontal probing depth beyond conventional counts and risk factors across separately sampled NHANES2009–2010(n=3139)and2011–2012(n=2790). Target weighted MSE gain was-0.000107mm²(400 source+target PSU-refit95%interval-0.002546to0.001226);source cross-validation gain was also negative. This is not proof of equivalence or absent biological information.
